#Expert_View 777#International🔰Bold Foreign Policy; a Prerequisite for Turning Crisis into Opportunity👤Ali Salehian, Director of the Elite Diplomacy Center at the Sharif Governance Think Tank, has written a note on the occasion of Government Week:🔹Government Week, in addition to being an opportunity to present the performance report of executive bodies, should also be a time for rethinking the quality of governance and the government's power of initiative. This necessity is doubly important in foreign policy—a field where developments do not wait for administrative processes and delayed decisions. 🔸 Alongside the continuity and professionalization of embassy media activities, the government should develop its narrative-building capacity by identifying and supporting articulate, multilingual, and timely figures.🔹Crisis is not necessarily the end of possibilities. If we speak courageously, choose tools and audiences creatively, and build networks before a crisis, we can turn the attention generated in the most difficult circumstances into an opportunity for influence. An innovative foreign policy does not make excuses out of limitations; it creates new possibilities from them.📌 Read the full text of the note on the think tank's website. 💠Sharif Governance Think Tank | Website | | Telegram Channel | | Bale Channel | | Rubika Channel | | Instagram |
